findings.title: Attention now separates expected refusals from actionable failures
findings.evidence: 228 historical expected refusals remain in the Job ledger while Attention contains 34 actionable items: 34 operational, 0 scientific and 0 approval waits.
findings.impact: Operators see a ranked intervention queue without losing scientific refusal history, and every new Job carries actor, command and request identity.
findings.action: Keep app.classify_job_outcome and app.v_attention under migration and contract gates.

findings.title: Observed command traces are bound to architecture nodes
findings.evidence: 1150 durable traces currently cover 13/18 commands; linked Jobs resolve to their eventual terminal outcome.
findings.impact: Command and method inspectors now expose empirical traffic, latency, cache and failure-path data.
findings.action: Let coverage accumulate from real use; do not manufacture traffic merely to turn coverage green.

findings.title: Twin invariants are enforced as architecture fitness functions
findings.evidence: Gate 14 verifies 18/18 handled commands, 12/12 implemented methods and 0 import cycles.
findings.impact: A future adapter bypass, duplicate owner or import cycle now fails the same gate that checks twin freshness.
findings.action: Keep each new invariant paired with a positive control that proves the checker can convict.

findings.title: Shell completeness and capability completeness are separate facts
findings.evidence: 8/8 Workspace shells and 30/30 View shells are navigable; 3/8 Workspaces and 7/30 Views have connected capability.
findings.impact: The full product can be walked and optimized without presenting planned scientific modules as working software.
findings.action: Keep shell-ready, capability-connected and observed usage as three independent dimensions.

nodes.summary: Highest occupied molecular orbital amplitude on a grid, from a real RHF/UHF wavefunction.
nodes.description: Runs an SCF and writes the HOMO amplitude as a Gaussian cube registered to the input geometry. Refuses rather than rendering a field from an unconverged wavefunction: a decorative isosurface is indistinguishable from a real one on screen.

nodes.summary: Lowest unoccupied molecular orbital amplitude on a grid, from a real RHF/UHF wavefunction.
nodes.name: fields.qm.lumo

nodes.summary: Electrostatic potential from the QM density, rather than from point charges.
nodes.name: fields.qm.mep_qm

nodes.summary: Electrostatic potential of an ARBITRARY ATOM SET, sampled in a caller-supplied box.
nodes.description: Both classical fields are EXACTLY linear in the atom set — measured on a shared grid, benzene plus acetate: |V_AB - (V_A + V_B)| / |V_AB| = 5.2e-16, machine precision. So a group field needs no bond perception, no capping, no valence and no molfile: it needs (element, position, charge) per atom and a box. That is why this is a separate method rather than a wider molfile input — the molfile path must perceive topology, and the topology builder cannot currently express more than one residue without silently dropping bonds. This method cannot hit that class of bug because it never asks.
nodes.name: fields.region.mep

So a group field needs no bond perception, no capping, no valence and no molfile: it needs (element, position, charge) per atom and a box. That is why this is a separate method rather than a wider molfile input — the molfile path must perceive topology, and the topology builder cannot currently express more than one residue without silently dropping bonds. This method cannot hit that class of bug because it never asks.

nodes.summary: SMILES or a 2D molfile to an ETKDG-embedded 3D conformer, MMFF-optimised where MMFF can type it.
nodes.description: The EXPLICIT step between a 2D input and any 3D physics method. It exists as its own method so that a field invocation never silently embeds: two methods ran, and the provenance says so.
nodes.name: molecule.embed

nodes.summary: Electrostatic potential on the molecular surface, from a QM density — the route that can answer a sigma-hole question.
nodes.description: Canonical QM surface-potential method. It runs through the shared invocation kernel, durable JobStore and content-addressed ArtifactStore; the legacy physics route is a compatibility adapter, not a second implementation.
